LanguageData.JLG_ModeDesc: Switch the whole connected fence between Barrier (a locked door that opens only for colonists and allies; hostiles must destroy a post) and Burn (anyone can walk through, hostiles are burned; it switches off while a non-hostile passes).
LanguageData.JLG_InspectBarrier: Barrier mode: opens only for colonists and allies.
LanguageData.JLG_InspectBurn: Burn mode: burns hostiles that walk through.
LanguageData.JLG_InspectNoLinks: No link: build another post in line within {0} tiles.
LanguageData.JLG_InspectOff: No power: the fence is down.
